note: Goblins, skeletons, slimes, and ogres now look like themselves: the monsters you meet in the wilds are drawn from new dedicated artwork instead of the old placeholder sheets — a goblin with its spear, a sword-and-shield skeleton, a bouncing green slime, and a club-wielding ogre that no longer borrows the troll picture. Their strength, behavior, and loot are exactly the same — only how they look has changed.
